title: The Lost Dog
synopsis: Saturday morning. A small wet dog on your porch with no tags. The rain isn't stopping.

nodes.text: He shivers at the door. He doesn't try to come in.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Heart.
“Bring a towel out” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: He sleeps on your old hoodie within twelve minutes.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Post photos online” back. Right shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Nobody recognizes him. A woman crosses herself. A kid hugs his neck.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Try the vet” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Try the shelter” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: The vet finds a chip. The owner moved out of state last year and didn't update.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honor.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Care—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: She is on the phone crying. He has been missing for fourteen months.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Care.
There is no taking “Offer to ship him properly” back. Practical shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She kneels on her driveway. He runs in a straight line.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Friend.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Quiet.

nodes.text: She sends you postcards forever. You frame the first one.
You almost gave him up. You almost did. The almost was a long second.
